query:
SELECT
            o.id,
            o.used_at AS "used_at!",
            o.revoked_at,
            c.client_name
        FROM oauth_authorizations o
        JOIN oauth_clients c ON c.client_id = o.client_id
        WHERE o.user_id = $1
          AND o.used_at IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY o.used_at DESC
